title: Detailed house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sky-free scene: house on ground -->
  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x='5' y='82' width='90' height='10' rx='3' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- House body -->
  <rect x='25' y='45' width='50' height='38' fill='#F4C27A'/>
  <!-- Body shading edge -->
  <rect x='25' y='45' width='50' height='4' fill='#E0A857'/>
  <rect x='25' y='45' width='4' height='38' fill='#E0A857'/>
  <!-- Roof -->
  <polygon points='50,18 20,46 80,46' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <polygon points='50,18 20,46 30,46' fill='#A93226'/>
  <!-- Chimney -->
  <rect x='63' y='24' width='9' height='16' fill='#B0653A'/>
  <rect x='63' y='24' width='9' height='3' fill='#8E4E2A'/>
  <!-- Smoke -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='18' r='3' fill='#D8DCE8'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#C4CADA'/>
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='43' y='60' width='14' height='23' rx='2' fill='#7B4B27'/>
  <rect x='43' y='60' width='14' height='3' fill='#5E381C'/>
  <!-- Door knob -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='72' r='1.6' fill='#F1C40F'/>
  <!-- Left window -->
  <rect x='30' y='55' width='10' height='10' fill='#8ED8F0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='55' width='10' height='2' fill='#6FC2DE'/>
  <rect x='34.5' y='55' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#E0A857'/>
  <rect x='30' y='59.5' width='10' height='1.5' fill='#E0A857'/>
  <!-- Right window -->
  <rect x='60' y='55' width='10' height='10' fill='#8ED8F0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='55' width='10' height='2' fill='#6FC2DE'/>
  <rect x='64.5' y='55' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#E0A857'/>
  <rect x='60' y='59.5' width='10' height='1.5' fill='#E0A857'/>
  <!-- Step -->
  <rect x='41' y='81' width='18' height='4' rx='1' fill='#9E9E9E'/>
  <!-- Flower left -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='78' r='3' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='78' r='1.3' fill='#F9E79F'/>
  <rect x='15' y='81' width='2' height='5' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <!-- Flower right -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='78' r='3' fill='#9B59B6'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='78' r='1.3' fill='#F9E79F'/>
  <rect x='83' y='81' width='2' height='5' fill='#2E8B57'/>
</svg>
